notes.title: Updates v0.9.25.47/48
notes.content:
[u][b]v0.9.25.47[/b][/u]
-- online updates --
[list]
[*] fix issue where a dead remote-character could appear in the wrong location
[*] prevent server from making too many items

[/list]
-- other --

[u][b]v0.9.25.48[/b][/u]

notes.title: Update 0.9.25.14
notes.content:
Misc polish

[list]
[*] Slightly better colors for color-blind folks (there's still more work to be done on this)
[*] QuickStart promoted to its own mode. When QuickStart is completed --> auto-select Battle mode
[*] fixed some colors in QuickStart
[*] prevented exiting a tutorial by just accidentally pressing "cancel" once too many times
[*] fixed issue where the dynamite tutorial could display the wrong score
[*] fixed issue where blastZones could appear on the level but be inactive given an odd interaction with the freezer powerup
[*] fixed issue where reading an old save file from the cloud could ignore new default levels, modes, characters
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.9.25.8
notes.content:
We've been doing a lot of work on online multiplayer. It's coming... but first comes this update with a bunch of misc things:

[list]
[*] New BotBattle mode where you can team up with 1-3 players to defeat bots in 7 progressively-more-challenging rounds.
[*] Your cannon’s deathBeam will immediately explode your bombs. This minor tweak makes cannons much more valuable for advanced play.
[*] Better resolution-handling – especially for people on 2+ monitor setups.
[*] Renamed “reference” button to “library” in an attempt to get people to notice it haha.
[*] DualSense controller support and controller vibration settings.
[*] Perfect hit – if you swing/throw your sword at the moment it flashes white – a bit of extra power.
[*] Removed Race mode – it would have taken a lot of work to polish this to being decent… and there are already a bunch of great race-platformers out there. (The “FlowCam” camera controller lives on in other projects…)
[*] Some new level backgrounds.
[*] Continuing tweaks on the QuickStart tutorial. Seems to be in a great place.
[*] Tons and tons of little tweaks/fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.8.0.3/2
notes.content:
A few small changes come in v0.8.0.3 and v0.8.0.2

[list]
[*] better support for Steam Controllers. However, standard Gamepad controllers (ds4, XboxOne, etc) are still recommended
[*] added 2 big experimental levels (Burning Divide and Chute)
[*] improved AI
[*] 2 more levels accessible in Horde Mode
[*] fixed rare level-select bug, overlapped text on trapShot tutorial, spelling fix
[/list]

notes.title: The Quick Start Update (v0.8)
notes.content:
This update (v0.8.0) focuses on the game’s early experience for new players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34997094/d31245f98144a9a64f5e834100c0f0bacddb11a7.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] a new "Quick Start" tutorial
[*] 4 new experimental levels, including one with vertical wraparound
[*] 3 new characters (Ticket, Bully, and Toad)
[*] Random level select
[*] Refined sword swinging -- pump-faking, exhaustion, and charge bonus if you time your swing perfectly
[*] New song: Luwuk Logic Bomb
[/list]

And lots more!
Check out the blog for full details: [url=https://www.whatnotory.com/2019/11/14/the-quick-start-update/]The Quick Start Update[/url]

notes.title: Boost Update released! (v0.7.9.10)
notes.content:
The Boost Update brings a *lot* of changes:
[list]
[*] Support for up to 8 players
[*] AI in Battle Mode
[*] New item in Race Mode: BOOST!
[*] New and refined race levels
[*] New characters
[*] Refined options menus
[*] New music
[*] Plus lots more including better color schemes, improved support for keyboard/mouse (though we still recommend using gamepads if you can!), and tons of bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.7.8.1
notes.content:
v0.7.8.1 brings a bunch of small changes:
[list]
[*] better interpretation of player’s intent for recoil at near-horizontal angles
[*] more reliable, slightly-easier sword swing mechanics and animations
[*] fixed an exploit where you could assign multiple jump buttons and then mash them all to climb super fast. (As one of the primary abusers of this exploit… I mourn the passing)
[*] Exploder mode: once again displays a running-out-of-time graphic — accidentally had hidden it in the previous version as part of a larger-scoped optimization
[*] fixed issue where items could fail some interactions with other objects after a player death
[*] Race mode: fixed error when an enemy-owned bomb was near a target at the moment the level was completed
[*] Race mode: easier to jump off stars
[*] a couple minor tweaks to some race levels
[/list]

notes.title: Jogging Update
notes.content:
The first pass at a new single-player mode: [b]Race[/b]!

[list]
[*] Get to the flag as fast as you can
[*] Collect stars, explode targets to improve your score
[*] Race against your best time (a simple ghost-playback)
[*] Compare your best scores with others using Steam leaderboards
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997094/d6a66de09eee72093bfa4df5a50e91011ca626ac.jpg[/img]

And other changes too
[b]See [url=http://www.whatnotory.com/2019/07/01/the-jogging-update/]here [/url]for more details and gifs![/b]

notes.title: Groundwork Update
notes.content:
v0.7.7.2 is available!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997094/0abbf594e9e977365e05be0e6747fdafd7ab60b2.jpg[/img]

The [b]Groundwork Update[/b] adds
[list]
[*] 2 new levels
[*] better controller assignment, disconnection, and reconnection
[*] better resolution of multiple button presses that map to the same action (e.g. jump)
[*] keyboard movement: the most recent directional-input takes priority
[*] more predictable thrownSword behavior near walls
[*] refined result of jumping/dashing off an item
[*] improved AI on tutorial levels
[*] better interaction with feedback form (F10)
[*] default keyboard controls now listed in the reference section
[*] misc bug fixes
[/list]

More info available [url=http://www.whatnotory.com/2019/06/14/the-groundwork-update/]here[/url]
